name: Dance of the Damned
source:
You wake up inside a dark place. You don't know where you are, or who you are, or who's that strange voice in your head. 

A supernatural forest, something behind the trees, a strange presence from the shadows. Can you find out what's happening before it was too late? You will fall deeper into a spiral of horror before remembering the horrifying truth… Do you dare to enter into this terrible dance?

[From [url=https://studiovictrix.itch.io/dance-of-the-damned]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个黑暗的地方醒来。你不知道自己在哪里，不知道自己是谁，也不知道脑海中那个奇怪的声音是谁。

一片超自然的森林，树后的某种东西，阴影中的奇怪存在。你能在为时已晚之前发现发生了什么吗？在记起可怕的事实之前，你会陷入更深的恐怖漩涡……你敢参加这可怕的舞蹈吗？

[来自[url=https://studiovictrix.itch.io/dance-of-the-damned]Itch.io[/url]]
